name: Tag
summary: Interactive label for chosen filters or values. Optionally removable with a close button.
avoid: Only showing a status: use Badge.
reactProps: Accessible name of the close button.
Used when removeLabel is not set. Defaults in DEFAULT_TAG_LABELS.
behaviour: The close button removes the tag. Then move focus to a logical place (the next tag or the filter field).
a11y: The close button is a <button> with a label like "Remove filter Active".
content: Show the value, not the category: "Amsterdam", not "Location".
do: Offer "Clear all" when there are more than three tags.
dont: Tags without a close button when you can remove them.
